name: SkyTrace
install: python3 --version && python3 scripts/extract_fixtures.py && python3 scripts/preflight.py && echo 'SkyTrace Python tooling OK (stdlib only, no external deps)'

terminals.name: legal-site
terminals.description: Serves the static bilingual legal/support site (docs/site) at http://localhost:8000 — the App Review Privacy/Terms/Support pages generated by scripts/generate_legal_site.py (this mirrors the GitHub Pages root).

terminals.name: app-preview
terminals.description: Serves the interactive web preview of the SkyTrace app at http://localhost:8001/preview/ — an operable, dependency-free rendering of the SwiftUI screens (Today/Map/Research/Settings, case detail, paywall) driven by the real demo fixtures via scripts/extract_fixtures.py. The compiled iOS app itself requires macOS + Xcode 26. Legal links resolve to the site at http://localhost:8001/site/.
